props.name: align
props.description:
Text alignment of the input. When omitted, the text is start-aligned in a `horizontal` input
without a decrement button (`decrement={false}`) and centered otherwise.

props.name: autofocus
props.description:
Whether the input is focused after mounting, by script rather than the native `autofocus`
attribute. Focus is skipped when the control is disabled, and `autofocusDelay` postpones it.

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds between mount and focusing the input. Only used with `autofocus`.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: decrement
props.description: Whether to render the decrement button. The button is also disabled automatically at `min`.

props.name: decrementDisabled
props.description: Whether the decrement button is disabled. Keyboard and wheel stepping stay available.

props.name: decrementIcon
props.description: Icon for the decrement button.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default numeric value for uncontrolled usage. Omit it or pass `null` to start empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The `id` of the `<form>` the control belongs to, for a control rendered outside that form.
It is set on the visible input and on the hidden input that submits the value under `name`.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
`Intl.NumberFormat` options for display formatting and parsing. The value stays a plain
number; only the displayed text is formatted.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: increment
props.description: Whether to render the increment button. The button is also disabled automatically at `max`.

props.name: incrementDisabled
props.description: Whether the increment button is disabled. Keyboard and wheel stepping stay available.

props.name: incrementIcon
props.description: Icon for the increment button.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref callback or variable that receives the visible `<input role="spinbutton">` element.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Amount added or subtracted by `PageUp` / `PageDown`, and by the wheel while `Shift` is held.

props.name: locale
props.description:
Locale for number formatting and parsing as a BCP 47 tag such as `en-US`.
Falls back to the provider locale, then `en-US`.

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum allowed value. Typed, stepped, and controlled values are clamped to it and it is
exposed as `aria-valuemax`. The `End` key jumps to it. Unbounded by default.

props.name: min
props.description:
Minimum allowed value. Typed, stepped, and controlled values are clamped to it; it anchors
the step grid and is exposed as `aria-valuemin`. The `Home` key jumps to it. Unbounded by default.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description:
Called when the input loses focus, before the typed text is committed. Calling
`preventDefault` skips that commit and the `Field` blur notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input gains focus. Calling `preventDefault` skips the `Field` focus notification.

props.name: onStep
props.description:
Called on each step: step button clicks, repeated steps while a button is held, keyboard
arrows (`ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` / `PageUp` / `PageDown`), and wheel stepping. `details`
carries the direction (`type`), the trigger source (`emitter`), the step amount
(`offset`), the stepped `value`, and the DOM `event`. For a button click it runs before
the step and calling `preventDefault` on the event cancels it; repeated, keyboard, and
wheel steps cannot be cancelled. It is not called while the control is disabled or the
step is out of range. Use `onValueChange` to observe every value change.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called when the committed value changes, with the value clamped to `min` / `max`, or `null`
when the input is cleared. Typing commits as soon as the text is a complete number; partial
text such as `-` waits for blur or `Enter`. Not called when the value is unchanged.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Visual layout direction.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown in the visible input while it is empty.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: repeat
props.description:
Press-and-hold repeat on the step buttons: `true` for the defaults, `false` to step only on
click, or an options object. Keyboard and wheel stepping are not affected.
examples:
import { NumberInput } from 'moraine'

<NumberInput repeat={{ delay: 300, interval: 50, pointerTypes: 'mouse' }} />

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount added or subtracted by the step buttons, `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown`, and the mouse wheel.

props.name: stepSnapping
props.description:
Whether stepping (buttons, arrow and `Page` keys, wheel) lands on the step grid anchored at
`min`, or at `0` without `min`; for example `step={5}` from `7` goes to `10`. Typed values are
only clamped, never snapped.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized message overrides for this number input instance: `increment` and `decrement` are
the `aria-label`s of the step buttons.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled numeric value. `undefined` keeps the input uncontrolled; `null` keeps it
controlled and empty. The displayed value is clamped to `min` / `max`; update it from
`onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: wheel
props.description:
Whether scrolling the mouse wheel over the focused input steps the value: up increments,
down decrements, and holding `Shift` uses `largeStep`. The page does not scroll while it
steps; `Ctrl` + wheel (zoom) is ignored.
